name: Phone bar: Home, Chats, Messenger, Apps
author: wizard
description: The phone's bottom bar is four fixed places around today's orb: Home and Chats on the left, Messenger and Apps on the right, each an icon with a label, instead of a row of desks and the +. Apps opens the app picker; the app you pick stays in Apps (its icon and name on the tile), and a sideways swipe on the tile flips between your last two apps. Hold Messenger to pin another app there. Every section keeps its place, and swiping sideways steps through the four.
